headline: French embassy in Congo faces backlash over visa video
description: The newspaper 'Le Canard enchaîné' uncovered a video produced by the French embassy in Brazzaville that many social media users condemned as racist. Published in June and deleted after just a few hours, it focused on the thorny issue of visas.

headline: On Biarritz's Port des Pêcheurs, Casa Juan Pedro keeps the plancha tradition alive
description: 'Gourmet kiosks' (5/6). Across France, small kiosks serving local specialties are a favorite stop for holidaymakers. Casa Juan Pedro, tucked in the cove of the Port des Pêcheurs in Biarritz, is one such place, where the plancha grilling ritual has been passed down from father to son for over 40 years.

headline: As Ebola spreads in DRC, declining international aid exposes the vulnerable

headline: 'Nolan's Odyssey is probably one of the most faithful cinematic adaptations of the Homeric text'
description: The British-American director's film prompts a nuanced and profound reflection on humanity. In doing so, it brings Homer's work powerfully into dialogue with the present, observes historian Fabien Bièvre-Perrin.
